_comment: 2008-2009 Audi TT Coupe 3.2 quattro (8J), US, 3.2 VR6, 02Q 6-speed manual, Haldex quattro (approximated by a centre differential), 245/45R17. Matches the CARLA vehicle.audi.tt body (8J). Draft from lab/cars/audittt-research.md; model fields come from the fit.
name: TT 3.2 quattro

sources.mass: Audi 2009 TT 3.2 sheet: 3,241 lb, 59/41; C&D test car 3,255 lb, 59.4/40.6 (used). CG 0.50 m is an estimate.
sources.engine: Audi sheet: 250 hp at 6300 rpm, 236 lb-ft at 2500-3000 rpm, CR 11.3, firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4. Curve outside the published points is an estimate.
sources.gearing: Audi sheet: 3.357/2.087/1.469/1.088 on 4.235, 1.108/0.912 and reverse 3.990 on 3.273. 5th, 6th and reverse scaled by 0.7729 to one 4.235 final drive.
sources.brakes: 340 mm vented front, 310 mm vented rear (Audi sheet). Torques are estimates; front share 0.80 is above the ideal up to 1.0 g.
sources.diff: Haldex coupling, open front with EDL, open rear (Audi). Approximated by a 0.6 front share and centre bias 3.0 (estimate).
sources.tyre_pressure: 34/32 psi from the 2008 TT 245/40R18 entry (tirepressure.com, secondary); 17 in value not found.
sources.calibration: Car and Driver, April 2007, 2008 TT 3.2 quattro manual: 6.1 s, 14.5 s at 97 mph, 159 ft, 0.93 g (ESP off).
sources.estimates: CG, inertia, springs, bars, dampers, alignment, brake torques, clutch, Haldex split, ESC gradient, frontal area, tyre curve. static_mu.
sources.static_mu: static_mu is required by the loader: 1.10 (992, matches tmeasy_peak_mu_x 1.15 less load sensitivity) / 0.97 (TT) are estimates.
sources.reference_corner_load_n: mass_kg x 9.81 / 4 (computed from the published mass).

calibration_open: C&D tyres unknown (17 or 18 in). Haldex modelled as a fixed-split centre differential. Audi claims 5.5 s to 60; calibrate to the measured 6.1 s without raising torque.
_model_note: No model yet (ticket #41). model_scene is a placeholder because the loader requires a non-empty value; the Cars spec replaces it with the fitted model. Physics fields beyond the draft are left to the Handling thread (#35).
